name: jev
description: Execution diagnostics, semantic Sift judgments, and optional native-subagent planning for Claude Code.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where to reach Jev: auto (JEV_PROVIDER, else the first provider key in the environment, else typesafe), typesafe, openrouter, vercel or opencode. Configuration saves its choice here

api_key.title: Jev API key
api_key.description: Optional sensitive credential. The masked Configuration field saves a validated provider/key pair to the local plugin store and attempts the sensitive option; the key is never kept in session state. Match provider to its issuer: auto treats this option as TypeSafe and an environment-detected provider uses its own environment key. Optional agent planning sends bounded task descriptions; explicit Sift commands send selected content and criteria. If empty, the selected provider's environment key is used.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Jev model id for semantic judgments and agent planning; empty uses the provider's default

min_confidence.title: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.description: Below this share (0 to 1), Jev's pick is ignored and Claude decides alone. Empty uses JEV_MIN_CONFIDENCE, else 0.7; a value outside 0 to 1 is ignored

timeout_ms.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long one Jev call may take, retry included, before failing open. Empty uses JEV_TIMEOUT_MS, else 4000; held between 500 and 30000

locale.title: Language
locale.description: Dashboard, commands and hints language. Auto follows the system locale.

routing_locale.title: Jev question language
routing_locale.description: Language of Jev's decision questions and criteria, independent of the dashboard. User conversation text is preserved.

claude_models.title: Claude agent candidates
claude_models.description: Optional comma-separated first-party Haiku, Sonnet and Opus model IDs supported by your account for eligible native-agent planning. Empty uses built-in IDs; unavailable choices fall back to the native request.
